docs.summary: Writes what an AI agent needs into a project when it opens. The prowl launcher in Library points at the running editor and is rewritten every time. The skills, CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md end with a marker holding a hash of their content: a file that still matches it is untouched and gets updated when the editor ships a newer version, a file someone edited no longer matches and is left alone, and deleting the marker line opts a file out for good.
